scope: Selected educational examples, not a systematic review or clinical guide.

primary.label: Primary Hallmarks
primary.description: Damage and maintenance processes. Groups organize this guide; they are not a clinical staging system.

antagonistic.label: Antagonistic Hallmarks
antagonistic.description: Responses and signaling processes with context-dependent effects.

integrative.label: Integrative Hallmarks
integrative.description: Processes involving tissue function and interactions across biological systems.

hallmarks.name: Genomic Instability
hallmarks.shortDescription: Damage to DNA and errors in chromosome maintenance.
hallmarks.mechanism: Damage to DNA and errors in chromosome maintenance.

measurements.name: Chromosome instability
measurements.description: The study assessed chromosome-number errors and chromosome-segregation machinery.
measurements.limitation: These endpoints are not interchangeable with RDW or MCV. No routine blood-marker mapping is retained here.

studies.title: BubR1 overexpression
studies.finding: Higher BubR1 expression reduced chromosome instability and delayed several age-related changes; lifespan increased in the studied mice.
studies.limitation: This genetic experiment does not establish a human treatment or a routine blood test for genomic instability.

hallmarks.uncertainty: This genetic experiment does not establish a human treatment or a routine blood test for genomic instability.

citations.title: Hallmarks of aging: An expanding universe.
Increased expression of BubR1 protects against aneuploidy and cancer and extends healthy lifespan.

hallmarks.name: Telomere Attrition
hallmarks.shortDescription: Loss of protective telomere integrity at chromosome ends.
hallmarks.mechanism: Loss of protective telomere integrity at chromosome ends.

measurements.name: Telomere length
measurements.description: Telomere length was assessed alongside tissue damage and regeneration.
measurements.limitation: Length describes telomeres in the sampled material; it is not an individual whole-body age or a treatment recommendation.

studies.title: Telomerase reactivation
studies.population: Engineered mice with severe telomerase deficiency
studies.finding: Reactivating telomerase restored telomeres and improved several degenerative tissue phenotypes in this deficiency model.
studies.limitation: Rescue of a severe engineered deficiency does not establish rejuvenation in normally aging humans.

hallmarks.uncertainty: Rescue of a severe engineered deficiency does not establish rejuvenation in normally aging humans.

citations.title: Hallmarks of aging: An expanding universe.
Telomerase reactivation reverses tissue degeneration in aged telomerase-deficient mice.

hallmarks.name: Epigenetic Alterations
hallmarks.shortDescription: Changes in the molecular regulation of gene activity.
hallmarks.mechanism: Changes in the molecular regulation of gene activity.

measurements.name: DNAm PhenoAge
measurements.description: A separate human study developed a DNA-methylation score associated with mortality and other aging outcomes.
measurements.limitation: Prediction is not proof of a causal mechanism. DNAm PhenoAge is distinct from a calculator using routine blood chemistry.

studies.title: Partial cellular reprogramming
studies.population: Premature-aging mice and older wild-type mice
studies.finding: Cyclic OSKM expression extended lifespan in a premature-aging mouse model. Separate experiments improved recovery from injury in older wild-type mice.
studies.limitation: The lifespan result belongs to the premature-aging model; it does not establish safe human reprogramming.

studies.title: DNA-methylation prediction
studies.population: Human cohorts used to develop and evaluate DNAm PhenoAge
studies.finding: The score was associated with mortality and other aging-related outcomes.
studies.limitation: An association or predictive score does not establish that changing the score changes an outcome.

hallmarks.uncertainty: The lifespan result belongs to the premature-aging model; it does not establish safe human reprogramming.

citations.title: Hallmarks of aging: An expanding universe.
In Vivo Amelioration of Age-Associated Hallmarks by Partial Reprogramming.
An epigenetic biomarker of aging for lifespan and healthspan.

hallmarks.name: Loss of Proteostasis
hallmarks.shortDescription: Failure to maintain a functional balance of cellular proteins.
hallmarks.mechanism: Failure to maintain a functional balance of cellular proteins.

measurements.name: Proteasome activity
measurements.description: The experiments measured protein-clearance machinery and resistance to proteotoxic stress.
measurements.limitation: This cellular process is not measured by serum albumin alone.

studies.title: RPN-6 expression
studies.finding: Increasing expression of a proteasome subunit improved resistance to protein-related stress and extended worm lifespan.
studies.limitation: A worm genetic experiment does not show that a supplement improves human protein maintenance or lifespan.

hallmarks.uncertainty: A worm genetic experiment does not show that a supplement improves human protein maintenance or lifespan.

citations.title: Hallmarks of aging: An expanding universe.
RPN-6 determines C. elegans longevity under proteotoxic stress conditions.

hallmarks.name: Disabled Macroautophagy
hallmarks.shortDescription: Impaired recycling of cellular material through macroautophagy.
hallmarks.mechanism: Impaired recycling of cellular material through macroautophagy.

measurements.name: Autophagic flux
measurements.description: The study assessed the recycling process in tissues alongside pathological changes.
measurements.limitation: A single routine blood value cannot substitute for the tissue measurements in this experiment.

studies.title: Beclin 1–BCL2 disruption
studies.finding: A mutation that weakened beclin 1–BCL2 binding increased basal autophagic flux and extended lifespan in male and female mice.
studies.limitation: This result is specific to a genetic model; it does not establish that a fasting schedule or supplement produces the same outcome in people.

hallmarks.uncertainty: This result is specific to a genetic model; it does not establish that a fasting schedule or supplement produces the same outcome in people.

citations.title: Hallmarks of aging: An expanding universe.
Disruption of the beclin 1-BCL2 autophagy regulatory complex promotes longevity in mice.

hallmarks.name: Deregulated Nutrient Sensing
hallmarks.shortDescription: Altered signaling through pathways that respond to nutrient availability.
hallmarks.mechanism: Altered signaling through pathways that respond to nutrient availability.

measurements.name: Survival under mTOR inhibition
measurements.description: The experiment tested survival after pharmacological inhibition of the mTOR pathway.
measurements.limitation: Survival is an outcome, not a blood assay for nutrient sensing; glucose alone does not measure this entire hallmark.

studies.title: Late-life rapamycin
studies.population: Genetically heterogeneous male and female mice at three sites
studies.finding: Rapamycin started at 600 days of age increased median and maximal lifespan in the studied mice.
studies.limitation: The mouse survival result does not establish a dose, benefit-risk balance, or lifespan extension for humans.

hallmarks.uncertainty: The mouse survival result does not establish a dose, benefit-risk balance, or lifespan extension for humans.

citations.title: Hallmarks of aging: An expanding universe.
Rapamycin fed late in life extends lifespan in genetically heterogeneous mice.

hallmarks.name: Mitochondrial Dysfunction
hallmarks.shortDescription: Disruption of mitochondrial function and quality control.
hallmarks.mechanism: Disruption of mitochondrial function and quality control.

measurements.name: Mitophagy and respiration
measurements.description: Experiments examined mitochondrial turnover and respiratory capacity.
measurements.limitation: These measurements are context-specific; routine blood counts do not directly quantify them.

studies.title: Urolithin A
studies.population: C. elegans, mice and rats; supporting laboratory experiments
studies.finding: Urolithin A induced mitophagy, extended worm lifespan and improved exercise capacity in rodent experiments.
studies.limitation: The lifespan result was in worms. This paper does not establish human lifespan extension.

hallmarks.uncertainty: The lifespan result was in worms. This paper does not establish human lifespan extension.

citations.title: Hallmarks of aging: An expanding universe.
Urolithin A induces mitophagy and prolongs lifespan in C. elegans and increases muscle function in rodents.

hallmarks.name: Cellular Senescence
hallmarks.shortDescription: Persistent cell-cycle arrest associated with altered cellular behavior.
hallmarks.mechanism: Persistent cell-cycle arrest associated with altered cellular behavior.

measurements.name: Senescent cells and secretions
measurements.description: The paper measured senescent cells, secreted cytokines and functional outcomes.
measurements.limitation: A nonspecific inflammatory blood marker alone does not identify the burden or location of senescent cells.

studies.title: Dasatinib plus quercetin
studies.population: Mice, with supporting human adipose-tissue experiments
studies.finding: Senescent-cell transplantation impaired mouse physical function. Senolytic treatment improved function and post-treatment survival in mouse experiments.
studies.limitation: Human tissue experiments are not human treatment trials. Mouse survival findings do not establish a human longevity benefit.

hallmarks.uncertainty: Human tissue experiments are not human treatment trials. Mouse survival findings do not establish a human longevity benefit.

citations.title: Hallmarks of aging: An expanding universe.
Senolytics improve physical function and increase lifespan in old age.

hallmarks.name: Stem Cell Exhaustion
hallmarks.shortDescription: Declining maintenance and regenerative function of tissue stem cells.
hallmarks.mechanism: Declining maintenance and regenerative function of tissue stem cells.

measurements.name: Satellite-cell regeneration
measurements.description: The experiments assessed muscle stem-cell state and regenerative capacity.
measurements.limitation: A peripheral blood count does not replace a functional assay of muscle stem cells.

studies.title: p16 silencing in satellite cells
studies.population: Geriatric mouse muscle stem cells; supporting human cell observations
studies.finding: Silencing p16 restored quiescence and regenerative function in geriatric mouse satellite cells.
studies.limitation: This tissue-specific experiment does not demonstrate a general human stem-cell rejuvenation treatment.

hallmarks.uncertainty: This tissue-specific experiment does not demonstrate a general human stem-cell rejuvenation treatment.

citations.title: Hallmarks of aging: An expanding universe.
Geriatric muscle stem cells switch reversible quiescence into senescence.

hallmarks.name: Altered Intercellular Communication
hallmarks.shortDescription: Changes in signals exchanged between cells and tissues.
hallmarks.mechanism: Changes in signals exchanged between cells and tissues.

measurements.name: Neural and cognitive endpoints
measurements.description: Researchers assessed hippocampal changes and specific behavioral tasks.
measurements.limitation: These findings do not establish a single circulating marker that measures all intercellular communication.

studies.title: Young circulatory environment
studies.population: Aged mice exposed to young circulation or plasma
studies.finding: Experiments reported improved hippocampal plasticity and performance on selected learning and memory tasks in aged mice.
studies.limitation: The study did not establish human cognitive rejuvenation or a reason to obtain young-plasma treatment.

hallmarks.uncertainty: The study did not establish human cognitive rejuvenation or a reason to obtain young-plasma treatment.

citations.title: Hallmarks of aging: An expanding universe.
Young blood reverses age-related impairments in cognitive function and synaptic plasticity in mice.

hallmarks.name: Chronic Inflammation
hallmarks.shortDescription: Persistent inflammatory activity associated with aging.
hallmarks.mechanism: Persistent inflammatory activity associated with aging.

measurements.name: Immune activation
measurements.description: The study assessed inflammatory signaling and organ-specific functional outcomes.
measurements.limitation: These endpoints do not justify treating a single inflammatory blood result as an aging diagnosis.

studies.title: Nlrp3 deletion
studies.population: Aged mice with genetically disrupted inflammasome signaling
studies.finding: Loss of Nlrp3 reduced age-related immune activation and improved selected metabolic, skeletal and neurological outcomes.
studies.limitation: Genetic deletion in mice is not evidence that lowering any inflammatory marker will extend human life.

hallmarks.uncertainty: Genetic deletion in mice is not evidence that lowering any inflammatory marker will extend human life.

citations.title: Hallmarks of aging: An expanding universe.
Canonical Nlrp3 inflammasome links systemic low-grade inflammation to functional decline in aging.

hallmarks.name: Dysbiosis
hallmarks.shortDescription: Changes in microbial communities and their interactions with the host.
hallmarks.mechanism: Changes in microbial communities and their interactions with the host.

measurements.name: Microbiome and immune profiling
measurements.description: The study combined microbial measurements with repeated immune profiling.
measurements.limitation: A change in diversity is an experimental observation, not a universal diagnostic threshold for healthy aging.

studies.title: Diet and microbiome intervention
studies.population: Healthy adults; 18 participants per arm over a 17-week study
studies.finding: The fermented-food arm increased microbiota diversity and reduced inflammatory markers. The high-fiber arm did not change the primary cytokine-response score.
studies.limitation: This small study measured microbiome and immune outcomes, not lifespan or reversal of biological aging.

hallmarks.uncertainty: This small study measured microbiome and immune outcomes, not lifespan or reversal of biological aging.

citations.title: Hallmarks of aging: An expanding universe.
Gut-microbiota-targeted diets modulate human immune status.
